    All Classes and Interfaces

    Classes
    Class
    Description
    Bout
    The Bout class represents a jousting match between two characters in the system.
    BoutMaker
    The BoutMaker class is responsible for simulating the generation of points for characters during a bout.
    BoutService
    The BoutService class provides service methods to manage Bout entities.
    Character
    The Character class represents a character entity in the jousting system.
    CharacterService
    The CharacterService class provides service methods to manage Character entities.
    ConsoleBoutMenu
     
    ConsoleCharacterMenu
     
    ConsoleHouseMenu
    The ConsoleHouseMenu class handles the display of the house-related menu and manages user interactions for house services.
    ConsoleMainMenu
    The ConsoleMainMenu class is responsible for displaying the main menu in the console application.
    House
    The House class represents a noble house entity in the system.
    HouseService
    The HouseService class provides service methods to manage House entities.
    Main
    Main class responsible for launching the application.
    MenuBoutOptions
    The MenuBoutOptions class provides the logic for handling bout-related operations such as listing all bouts, adding new bouts, simulating a bout, or querying bouts by specific criteria.
    MenuCharacterOptions
    The MenuCharacterOptions class provides the logic for handling character-related operations such as listing all characters, adding a new character, or querying characters by their house or character key.
    MenuHouseOptions
    The MenuHouseOptions class handles all operations related to house management.
    MenuMainOptions
    The MenuMainOptions class manages the display and navigation between the different service options in the application's main menu.
